findings: Current typed region does not bind LayerNorm; existing native shader remains the implementation.
Original norm.comp uses mean of squares minus square of mean. Original group_norm.comp first reduces mean, then sums squared centered values.
Canonical ggml shape [width,1,1,rows] with one group normalizes each contiguous row; original Vulkan dispatch is rows groups in X with 512 invocations per group.
Generic vk_op_push_constants does not carry byte-origin offsets and asserts descriptor alignment; ordinary cold region adapters must supply aligned storage.
GroupNorm output must be restored to HYLE logical shape; a published view alone is not an owning output port. No-affine path uses original Cont, affine path finishes with original Mul/Add.
Existing HYLE Cast/Copy plus dense alias can adapt noncontiguous/high-rank/half inputs through F32; scale/bias convert separately and final half cast follows affine.
At most five original ggml tensor/node objects per LayerNorm (input reshape, GroupNorm, output reshape or Cont, optional Mul/Add) plus existing region overhead.
decision: Borrow original GroupNorm and native region; implement bounded dtype/layout, metadata, hardware-domain and output-owner adapters. No vendor algorithm change.
limits: No GPU execution or numerical qualification in this audit.
No changes to CPU qualification blocker or public validation instruments.
